integrity: The target open article was inspected at the hierarchy, observed likelihood, complete-data likelihood, EM E-step, M-step, corrected eta score, simulation implementation note, and real-data estimation method. A closely related prior gamma-frailty article was inspected at its complete-data likelihood and lambda score. The correction follows algebraically from normalized probability densities, and a standalone checker replays the score identities and bounded-versus-unbounded auxiliary functions.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the printed joint three-parameter EM formulation and does not establish which complete-data expression was used in unavailable code.
The simulation fixes the frailty shape and states that a corrected complete-data log-likelihood was used; the real-data analysis uses direct observed-likelihood maximization.
The corrected frailty-shape auxiliary function is proved to attain a finite maximum, but uniqueness is not claimed for every frozen E-step.
title: Missing normalizers make the printed LGF EM objective unbounded in frailty shape
